text: ὁ Ἔμπορος βάλλει λίθον κατὰ τὸν ὄφιν.
objects: a smooth round gray stone about the size of an apple
positioning: Emporos hurls the stone with one arm extended toward Ophis, his face showing determination
Ophis recoils as the stone flies toward him, his eyes wide with alarm
Panda and Dinosaur peek out from behind Emporos with hopeful expressions
The smooth round gray stone about the size of an apple hurtles through the air toward Ophis
